title: Pick accounting software
ask: The spreadsheet is not coping, so I want proper accounting software. Three options are in sources/options.md. Please give me a brief with one pick.
background: We are two people, registered for GST, and send about 40 invoices a month.
Our bookkeeper, Marguerite, needs her own login.

constraints.text: write the monthly cost of your pick as "Monthly cost: $...", and it must be $40 or under
start the brief with a first line that reads "Pick: " and the product name
none of the sales words "best-in-class", "game-changer" or "no-brainer"
work only from the snapshot, no web lookups
do actually open sources/options.md rather than going from memory
say that Marguerite gets her own login

start.sources/options.md:
# Accounting software

Snapshot taken 1 March 2026. All prices in Australian dollars.

| Option | Price | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ledgerly Standard | $32 a month | unlimited invoices, GST reports, 2 users plus bookkeeper login |
| Tally Lite | $15 a month | 20 invoices a month, GST reports, 1 user |
| Brookfield Books | $65 a month | unlimited invoices, GST reports, payroll, 5 users |
